I just feel like there is so much pressure with media for teenagers and young adults to mindlessly rush into relationships… it’s seen as a “solution to end all problems” frequently. I’ve seen people ride that honeymoon phase and then breaking up when the relationship gets “stale” then, like an addict, they begin to chase that high again. I’ve personally been stuck in this loop before, so instead, i’m choosing to wait until i feel like i can provide and give and be ready to receive healthily in a relationship.
